expected.interpretation: If the Janabiyah seal owner's name carried multiple miin (fish/star) morphemes per Parpola's Dravidian hypothesis, Akkadian scribes would have rendered it as multiple mi-in / me-en / mi-na syllables in clay tablets. A significant cluster of such tablets in the same period + provenience as Janabiyah (Early Dilmun ~2100-2000 BC, Bahrain) would be a phonetic anchor candidate.
